machine.gpu: Mesa Intel Iris Xe (Tiger Lake GT2)

workload.scope: Real installed application entry point inside Flatpak, using disposable SQLite backups
workload.instrumentation: JFR profile and MethodTrace; synchronous AWT wheel dispatch, without forced repaint

after.renderer: OPENGL via native Wayland EGL subsurface
after.artifact: Rebuilt and installed Flatpak; application classes loaded exclusively from /app/lib

limits: One diagnostic run per mode; these are not FPS or physical input-to-presentation latency.
JFR and method tracing perturb execution; filesystem, JVM and graphics caches were not controlled.
The injection loop waits for EDT dispatch, so slower modes receive a slower input stream.
Scroll positions and frame counts differ because smooth scrolling and the event loop are asynchronous.
The renderer uses Compose input and scene management while replacing only native Wayland presentation.
